consent.title: Before you play: what happens to your votes

play.title: Only to play.
play.text: We use your votes, predictions and reactions to play, with your group or alone, and to show the result. When you vote alone, your vote adds, without your name, to the world result of that dilemma, and we only keep a record that you already voted on it.

notSold.title: We do not sell them or use them for ads.
notSold.text: Under this consent we give them to nobody, and we do not use them to profile you or for research.

group.title: Only your group sees them,
group.text: in the reveal of each dilemma. In an anonymous room, not even that: only the split, without names.

deleted.title: They are deleted within 24 hours
deleted.text: of the room closing. Only your history is kept, on your phone, until you delete it.

decide.title: You decide.
decide.text: You need no name or email to play, and you can withdraw this consent by writing to privacidad@thelever.app.

consent.why: Why we ask for it separately: a vote on a dilemma can show what you think or something about your private life, and data protection law (GDPR) requires express consent for that.
consent.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>terms of use</terms>.
consent.statement: I give my explicit consent for TheLever to process my votes, predictions and reactions, and what others predict or react about me, only to play and as explained above. I know they can show my beliefs or something about my private life and that I can withdraw this consent at any time.
consent.declined: Without this you cannot play: your votes and predictions are the game.
consent.changed: We have changed the game consent. Read it and give it again to keep playing.

newTerms.title: We have changed the terms of use
newTerms.lead: To keep playing, read them and accept them.
newTerms.check: I have read and accept the new terms of use.
newTerms.declined: Without accepting them you cannot play. You can accept them whenever you want.

funding.title: How it is funded
funding.lead: TheLever is free. This is how it is paid for:

ads.title: Ads.
ads.text: Never while you vote, and they never get anything of what you vote.

research.title: Later on, maybe research.
research.text: If we ever want to use games for research, we will ask for your consent separately. If you say no, you play the same.

donations.title: Donations.
donations.text: If you like it, you can help keep it going with a donation. Donating gives you no advantage in the game. Everyone plays the same.
donations.label: Support TheLever (opens in the browser)
